set.body: From the Opus review of C5 (complete B-spline). Primitive.pointsFor caps Gauss-Legendre at 4 points (Primitive.scala:256-258), exact only to degree 7; both B-spline conventions accept any degree >= 0 and the descriptor advertises PiecewisePolynomial, docs say 'exact'. Measured errors vs 2e5-pt trapezoid: 1.7e-5 (deg 8), 5.7e-5 (9), 1.9e-4 (12). Pre-existing (legacy too). Fix: raise the cap / choose points from degree, or fall back to Quadrature, or refuse degree > 7; tests at degree 8-12. Related nits: Hrf.name is 'bspline' for both conventions (cosmetic); no HrfSpec/formula path selects BsplineConvention.Complete (scope gap).
set.title: B-spline window means are not exact for degree >= 8 (Gauss-Legendre capped at 4 points)
